chunks: All praise be to God, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of all the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for God to be the Lord of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty (Rububiyyah) over both the visible cosmos and the unseen realms, reinforcing the monotheistic foundation of faith. It serves as a preamble to divine judgment, reminding believers that all creation is subject to His will and that true gratitude is due solely to Him, distinct from any partners or intermediaries.
